info.name: Secret Santa
info.description:
Organize a Secret Santa gift exchange ("Wichteln") with Nextcloud users and external guests.
- Create lists of participants, both Nextcloud users and guests by name and email - Write the email every participant receives - Draw the partners and notify every participant by email whom to give a gift - Nobody draws the same partner as in the previous draw - Exclude partners, e.g. couples, from drawing each other
info.author: Ferdinand Thiessen
